name: predictive-text

frames.best_why: A partly typed message, two word suggestions in the pill and the send button are all visible at once.

tagline: Word suggestions float above the message box as you type.
summary: A rounded message composer that watches the word you are part-way through and floats a small pill of completions above it. Tab cycles the options, arrow-right accepts one and Enter sends.
appearance: A wide dark rounded message field with bold pale text and faint image and microphone icons at its right edge. Above its left end floats a small dark pill of bold suggested words divided by hairline rules, and a round light send button appears inside the field once there is text.
behaviour: Typing the start of a word raises up to three matching completions in the pill, taken from the dictionary and words sent before. Tab moves the highlight along the list, arrow-right accepts the first, Enter takes the highlighted word or sends the message, and Escape clears it.
demo_content: Placeholder "Message Maya"; the typed message builds to "let's meet for dinner tomorrow".
search_phrases: message box that suggests the next word
autocomplete word pills above an input
type ahead suggestions for a chat composer
text field with tappable word completions
smart keyboard style next word hints
floating suggestion chips over a message box
how to add next word suggestions to a chat
use_when: A lightweight chat or comment field should speed up typing without a full autocomplete dropdown.
avoid_when: It matches only the current word and needs a word list; with an empty dictionary it never suggests anything.
customise: Supply a dictionary array and a placeholder, and hook onSend to receive the finished message. The word matching, the three-item cap and the frequency learning are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One input, a short list of words and a spring on the suggestion pill; nothing loops.

a11y.note: Tab, arrows and Enter work, but the field is named only by its placeholder and the suggestion buttons have no focus ring.

issues: The input has no name beyond its placeholder, and the suggestion buttons show no focus style.
Frames 1 and 2 show a large empty band above the field where the suggestions will appear.
polish_why: Clean rounded field and tidy suggestion pill, but ordinary layout and a large empty gap above.
